purpose: Choose the finest geographic scale that can support a shared demographic forcing factor for each Pygoscelis species without inspecting count magnitudes.
level_selection_rule: For a species, choose the first level in the fixed hierarchy for which every frozen bridged unit belongs to a qualifying group. Missing geography labels or unsupported small groups make that level incomplete and force fallback. Do not drop units to rescue a finer level.
boundary: Count is used only as a non-missingness flag to reconstruct the already-frozen nest-count cohort.
No count magnitude is summarized, compared, transformed, modeled, printed or written to the audit outputs.
No site trait is used in this audit.
The 107-unit cohort and 1980-2025 breeding-season window cannot be changed to rescue a finer forcing scale.
If species-wide support fails, the shared-forcing loading model is not opened for that species.
